seoTitle: 24/7 Emergency Care in Ahmedabad | Silver Touch Hospitals
description: Silver Touch Hospitals offer 24/7 emergency and critical care in Ahmedabad. Private & public emergency hospital in Satellite-Prahladnagar and Nirnaynagar.
html:
Critical Care at Silver Touch Hospitals - Your Go-to Network of a 24/7 Critical Care Hospital in Ahmedabad

Life hangs in the balance when it comes to life-threatening conditions. Silver Touch Hospitals‘ Critical Care Unit is set up to handle situations at a moment’s notice, with swift action, efficiency, and empathy. With fully-equipped ICU facilities across our network of hospitals and an expert team on call 24/7, we’re ready to address even the most complicated medical crises.

Round-the-Clock Critical Care You Can Count On

As a reliable 24/7 Critical Care Hospital in Ahmedabad, our facilities are designed for round-the-clock monitoring and intervention. Critical care patients are handled by intensivists and specialists who collaborate across departments to provide instant, coordinated treatment.
These are the things that differentiate the critical care services offered by our network of emergency care hospital in Ahmedabad:

  • Dedicated ICU Units: Monitored beds with state-of-the-art life support systems
  • Senior Intensivists on Duty: Present day and night for clinical decision-making
  • Specialist Support: Smooth transition with cardiology, nephrology, pulmonology, and other specialists
  • Infection Control Protocols: Stringent hygiene and sterilisation protocols to minimise risk
  • Bedside Diagnostics: Immediate access to imaging and laboratory testing for fast treatment

Emergency Care That Doesn't Wait

Emergencies don’t have office hours — and neither do we. Our staff is trained to manage sudden cardiac arrest, respiratory failure, sepsis, stroke, trauma, and more.
We’re not merely an ICU unit. We are a 24 hours hospital in Ahmedabad, which means:

  • Emergency admissions at any time of the day or night
  • Ambulances are fully equipped with onboard medical facilities
  • In-house pharmacy, diagnostics, and support staff on standby
  • ICU backup is always available for patients who rapidly deteriorate

Our Commitment to Emergency Care

We serve patients across the city who are looking for immediate and professional care. If you’re searching for a private emergency hospital in Ahmedabad, we’re here to provide the medical expertise and attention your condition demands, without delay.
Our critical care team is trained to:

  • Stabilise patients in critical condition
  • Manage multi-organ complications
  • Provide ventilator and dialysis support when required
  • Begin post-surgical intensive recovery plans

Personalised Care in Private Settings at Silver Touch Hospitals

We provide the advantages of critical care with personal care at Silver Touch Hospitals. If your loved one requires immediate medical assistance in a secure and controlled environment, we provide that privacy and dedicated care in every one of our branches. We are the reason families prefer us when they want a private emergency hospital in Ahmedabad to treat critical cases without any compromise.

faqs.q: When would I recognise that someone requires critical care right away?
faqs.a: Symptoms such as unconsciousness, chest pain, acute respiratory distress, or trauma following an injury could necessitate ICU admission. Call our emergency number immediately.

faqs.q: Do your facilities accept trauma or accident-related cases?
faqs.a: Yes. We have trauma management and surgical stabilisation-trained emergency and ICU staff.

faqs.q: What level of monitoring do you provide in the ICU?
faqs.a: We employ multi-parameter monitors, ventilators, infusion pumps, and sophisticated diagnostic equipment for 24/7 monitoring.

faqs.q: Can I see the physicians treating my family member?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer daily reports and consultations with our ICU specialists to families.
